thread:
maya: Heads up — after the overnight CUDA12 rollout we're seeing a spike in failed model loads in eu-west clusters. Errors look like a DLPack ABI mismatch. @eli can you take a look?
eli: On it. Quick glance at node logs shows unresolved symbol in dlpack extension. snippet: ```dlpack_ext.so: undefined symbol: DLDeviceType at dlpack.cpp:142```
samir: Not the usual ld-linux mismatch. This smells like a python wheel built against CUDA11 headers but running on CUDA12 runtime.
lia: Which image tag is affected? all-runtimes or just the quant build?
maya: builder tag is `rwinf/runtime:2025-11-cuda12-quant` — but we've seen failures on both quant and base images that pulled the same wheel layer.
ops-bot: Node group cg-eu-west-3 completed image refresh at 03:12 UTC (autoscaler triggered).
eli: Quick repro command for anyone debugging: `python -c "import importlib, sys, dlpack_ext; print(dlpack_ext.__file__)"` then `ldd /opt/conda/lib/python3.9/site-packages/dlpack_ext.so`
eli: ldd output example: ```
libcudart.so.12 => not found
libstdc++.so.6 => /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 (version GLIBCXX_3.4.29)
undefined symbol: DLDeviceType```
samir: We ran ldd on one of the failing pods — libcudart points to the system cuda12 install but the wheel expects older dlpack symbols. Also build cluster uses gcc13 which exposes newer GLIBCXX that older runtime libs don't provide.
lia: There's another thing: PTX JITs are firing repeatedly after the rebuild, causing high CPU and long startup. Logs show repeated: `ptxjit: compiling PTX for kernel conv1 ...` across many containers — looks like PTX cache invalidation after the toolkit transition.
maya: Cost/ops impact: affected nodes auto-restarted ~3x over 6 hours due to OOM/race -> extra provisioning and spot churn, rough hit ~€1.2k so far (ballpark). Need fast mitigation.
eli: Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) rollback the runtime wheel to a CUDA11-compatible build (if we have one cached); 2) build a 'compat' image that bundles the cuda11 dlpack header shims; 3) patch build pipeline to compile wheels against cuda12 headers with pinned libstdc++.
lia: Starting a canary: i'll route 5 nodes in eu-west-2 to the compat image and monitor.
samir: QA checklist before wider rollout: run NCCL ring tests, embeddings pipeline smoke, and `python -c "import dlpack; print(dlpack.__version__)"` for sanity. Also validate `GLIBCXX` symbols: `strings /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6 | grep GLIBCXX`
maya: If we can't stabilize within 3h, fallback routing plan: divert model-serving traffic to dedicated us-east pool (lower latency for some users but keeps SLA). I'll open a routing change PR.
deploy-bot: Started rollout job `canary/compat-image/eu-west-2` (5 nodes) at 04:22 UTC.
ops-bot: Incident annotated: seed cause "toolkit->runtime header mismatch"; severity escalated to medium. Paging infra-oncall.
eli: I'll start a rebuild of the dlpack wheels on a gcc12 builder and upload to our internal wheel index. If that finishes we can swap images without touching the kernel.
lia: Monitoring dashboards: ptx compile rate, dlopen failures, and pod restarts. I'll add alerts to reduce noise but catch recurrence.
maya: Thanks — keep notes in the incident doc. Ping here for any blocking test failures.
samir: small nudge — also check CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES env propagation in entrypoint; we saw one pod with wrong device mapping during the restart loop.
maya: noted. will include in runbook. :thumbsup:
eli: PR for rebuilt wheels: https://git.internal/rwinf/wheels/pulls/58 — CI uses gcc12 image, starting build now.
lia: Canary metrics after 20m: no new dlpack errors on compat nodes, PTX compile spikes reduced by ~70%.
maya: Good progress. If green at 1h we'll stage a wider rollout. Thanks all.
